en: The postcard shows a tree-lined avenue with tall, well-maintained trees on both sides, creating a green corridor effect. There are a few small figures of people strolling or seated along the path, suggesting a leisurely atmosphere. The sepia-tone image has a distinct early 20th-century look. The text at the bottom of the image reads: 'BAD PYRMONT, DREI ALLEEN'. The reverse features handwritten German text, a stamp from the 'Deutsches Reich,' and is addressed to someone in Hamburg. The card is also stamped by a museum in Bad Pyrmont.
